readout.summary: Five of six sources back unbeaten USC (6-0) over unbeaten South Carolina (5-0) at Acrisure Arena in Palm Desert, a neutral site. Bang The Book takes USC on the moneyline, Pick Dawgz and iHeart take USC against the spread, and the CappersPicks AI model projects USC by 22 (88-66); iHeart and Bleacher Nation both project USC 81-66.
